title: 第4章 豪门千金（4）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    原主对南宫家挺熟悉的，带着楚棠往南宫景的房间三楼去。

    “乘月，诶……这位……”蓝雪正好从三楼下来，看到时笙旁边的楚棠直接愣在了那里。

    这个男人……好帅，比南宫景还要帅上许多，她竟然没发现宴会上来了这么一个极品男人。

    看到蓝雪眼底的痴迷，楚棠邪气的笑了笑，那笑容像是开到糜烂的花朵，引人迷恋却忍不住随他堕落。

    时笙站在楚棠前面，自然没看到楚棠的笑容，否则她只会大呼变态。

    “我没看到南宫景，我去房间找找他，你要一起吗？”多个人看到，多个证人嘛！

    有楚棠那么一个养眼的帅哥在，蓝雪没有丝毫犹豫的就同意了。

    “你好……我，我叫蓝雪。”

    时笙这个时候还看不出蓝雪的意图，那就是蠢了。

    她后背僵了僵，后面可是个大变态，蓝雪也是勇气可嘉。

    楚棠若是知道时笙在心底给他的定位，肯定会大呼冤枉，他明明什么都没做，怎么就是大变态了？

    时笙不理会后面的人，快速的朝着南宫景房间逼近。

    在门口站定，她也没敲门，直接就开门进去，值得庆幸的是南宫景并没有锁门。

    “阿景，我……”时笙的声音嘎然而止。

    随之溢出的是奇异的呻吟声，但是也仅仅是一秒，房间像是陷入了死寂。

    蓝雪本是和楚棠搭话，听到这声音也停了下来，看向被时笙推开的门缝，里面的景色落入她眼中。

    南宫景僵在苏衣衣身上，显然是没想到这个时候有人会进来，几秒钟后苏衣衣才反应过来，尖叫着推开南宫景。

    “谁许你进来的，不知道敲门吗？”南宫景将被单裹在苏衣衣身上，恼怒的瞪着时笙。

    时笙的手缓慢从门把上抽离，将酝酿好的情绪爆发出来，一副看到自家未婚夫和别人啪啪伤心欲绝，生无可恋的模样。

    “我在外面等你们。”时笙将门合上，“蓝雪，可以帮我去叫我爸爸和伯父伯母他们吗？”

    蓝雪愣愣的点头，小跑着下了楼。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The original owner was quite familiar with the Nangong family and took Chu Tang to the third floor of Nangong Jing’s room.

"Chengyue, eh...this..." Lan Xue happened to come down from the third floor and was stunned when she saw Chu Tang next to Shi Sheng.

This man... is so handsome, much more handsome than Nangong Jing. She didn't even notice that such a top-notch man came to the banquet.

Seeing the obsession in Lan Xue's eyes, Chu Tang smiled evilly. The smile was like a blooming flower, which attracted people's fascination but couldn't help but fall with him.

Shi Sheng stood in front of Chu Tang, so naturally she didn't see Chu Tang's smile, otherwise she would just call him perverted.

"I didn't see Nangong Jing. I went to the room to look for him. Do you want to come with me?" Multiple people saw it, and there were multiple witnesses!

With such an eye-catching handsome guy like Chu Tang, Lan Xue agreed without any hesitation.

"Hello...I, my name is Lan Xue."

"Shi Sheng is stupid if he can't see Lan Xue's intention at this time.

Her back was stiff, there was a big pervert behind her, and Lan Xue was also very brave.

"If Chu Tang knew the position Shi Sheng gave him in his heart, he would definitely cry out that he was wronged. He obviously didn't do anything, so how could he be such a pervert?

Shi Sheng ignored the people behind him and quickly approached Nangong Jing's room.

Standing at the door, she opened the door directly without knocking. Fortunately, Nangong Jing did not lock the door.

"A Jing, I..." Shi Sheng's voice stopped abruptly.

What followed was a strange moaning sound, but it was only for a second, and the room seemed to fall into deathly silence.

Lan Xue was talking to Chu Tang, but she stopped when she heard the voice. She looked at the crack in the door pushed open by Shi Sheng, and the scenery inside fell into her eyes.

Nangong Jing froze on Su Yiyi, obviously not expecting anyone to come in at this time. It took a few seconds for Su Yiyi to react, screaming and pushing Nangong Jing away.

"Who allowed you in? Don't you know how to knock?" Nangong Jing wrapped the sheet around Su Yiyi and stared at Shi Sheng angrily.

Shi Sheng's hand slowly pulled away from the doorknob, and he burst out the brewing emotions. He looked as if he was heartbroken after seeing his fiancé having sex with someone else, and had no love left.

"I'll wait for you outside." Shi Sheng closed the door, "Lan Xue, can you help me call my father, uncle, and aunt?"

Lan Xue nodded blankly and trotted downstairs.
